question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"bills."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"bills"** is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1. • **"Bills"** refer to a request for payment of money owed, or the piece of paper on which it is written. (बकाया पैसे के भुगतान के लिए अनुरोध, या कागज का टुकड़ा जिस पर यह लिखा गया है) • **Example**: *They sent us **bills**__ for the work they had done.* • So, the most appropriate answer for this blank is **"bills."** • The correct answer is Option 3. • **Correct sentence**: Workers' compensation benefits in Pennsylvania should pay for your medical __**bills**__ and a portion of your lost wages. However, you cannot be ______ (2) ______ for pain and suffering or other non-financial damages that your illness or injury may ______ (3) ______ you. A personal injury or wrongful death lawsuit, on the other hand, ______ (4) ______ compensation for the ill worker or surviving family members. If someone ______ (5) ______ your employer or a co-worker was to blame for your illness, you could pursue such a claim. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"States"** may refer to political entities within a country or a nation. (राज्‍य (जिसे एक निश्चित शासन के अंतर्गत संगठित एक राजनीतिक समुदाय माना जाए), देश) • **"Regulations"** are rules or directives issued by a government or an authority. (नियम या क़ानून (कुछ नियंत्रित करने का)) • **"Rules"** are guidelines or principles that govern behavior or actions. (खेल आदि का नियम, क़ायदा) 43:Tf0c, The correct answer is **"paid."**
